name: Hanover College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college with ~1,070 undergraduates. Ranked tied for #103 of 211 in National Liberal Arts Colleges by U.S. News & World Report (2025). Offers ~40 undergraduate majors plus DPT and OTD graduate programs; students may design their own major.
financial_aid: Tuition rate locked for four years. The college states 100% of Hanover students receive financial aid, and all undergraduates receive a merit-based scholarship ranging from $20,000 to $36,000 based on GPA. All forms of aid and grants cannot exceed the cost of tuition. Select Pell-eligible students from all 50 states may receive full tuition through combined aid (conditions apply). 2026-2027 total cost of attendance for residential first-year students is $63,819 before aid.
facilities_notes: Softball team plays at Kops-Bedel Stadium. Other campus athletic facilities include Alumni Stadium, Collier Arena, K.T. Young Ballpark (baseball), Horner Health & Recreation Center with weight room, cross country course, golf facilities, soccer complex, and Zeddies Tennis Center.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference (HCAC). As a D3 program, no athletic scholarships are offered; financial support is need- and merit-based academic aid.
notes: Data gathered from athletics.hanover.edu softball coaches and roster pages and hanover.edu cost/financial aid pages, checked 2026-07. Team X/Twitter account @HanoverSBall appears in site navigation but is not tied to any individual coach. As an NCAA D3 program, athletic scholarships are not permitted (scholarship_count null).
